data.name: Search_Description
data.value: Searches the web and returns a few results: title, address and a short extract. Use it for recent facts or anything you do not know. Read a result with fetch_url when the extract is not enough.

data.name: Search_Query
data.value: The words to search, as a person would type them in a search engine.

data.name: Search_Discloses
data.value: The words of the search go to the search engine, or to Brave Search when its key is set.

data.name: Fetch_Description
data.value: Reads the text of a web page from its address. Long pages come in parts: call again with 'start' set to the 'next_start' of the previous result. Addresses of this computer and of the local network are refused.

data.name: Fetch_Url
data.value: The address of the page, starting with https:// or http://.

data.name: Fetch_Start
data.value: Position of the first character to read, 0 by default.

data.name: Fetch_Discloses
data.value: The address of the page goes to its site, which sees a request from this computer.
